summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour presents Islamic teachings on repentance and seeking forgiveness from Riyadul Saliheen, Al-Nawawi's collection. He discusses a hadith from Ibn Umar about the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) reciting the supplication 'My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance, for You are the Oft-Returning, the Merciful' up to 100 times in a single gathering, as reported by Abu Dawood and Al-Tirmidhi. Sh. Ali Mashhour also shares another hadith from Ibn Abbas emphasizing that whoever persistently seeks forgiveness from Allah will receive relief from distress, worry, and provision from unexpected sources.
suggested_title: The Practice of Seeking Forgiveness: Hadiths from Riyadul Saliheen
hadith_chapter: Chapter on Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
